notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.98

• DuckAI writes down what you say in the language you actually spoke: English with an accent isn't turned into German any more, and short phrases like "ja öffnen" aren't taken for Finnish.
• DuckAI speaks without long pauses at full stops, commas and dashes.
• "Call Anna on WhatsApp" / "Ruf Anna auf WhatsApp an": DuckAI starts a WhatsApp call after you say yes, and finds the right person even when the name was misheard a little.
• DuckAI no longer suggests the Google Play Store: apps come from DuckStore.
• DuckPay: the face tile goes once it knows you, and in the card chooser your current card stays in its place in the stack.
• Uninstalling an app from the home screen or the app list asks in DuckOS's own style.
• Holding an app in the app list and dragging it never leaves it stuck on the screen any more.
• Settings › Accounts: each account shows its app, and adding one opens the app to sign in (WhatsApp no longer just closes).
• Updates download only with at least 20 % battery or the charger in. Battery saver turns itself on at 15 %.
